# PaySwap final reconciliation matrix — SYS-003

**Status:** NORMATIVE SYSTEM CLOSURE EVIDENCE (SYS-003 deliverable)
**Machine artifact:** `spec/system-closure/final-reconciliation-matrix.json` (this file is its human mirror — both machine-generated by `scripts/generate_final_reconciliation_matrix.mjs`; never hand-typed)
**Closure gate:** `scripts/test_system_closure.mjs` (re-derives every row at run time and fails closed on divergence)
**Work order:** `spec/system-work-orders/SYS-003.md`

The single composed view of system completeness across the three layers. Every
acceptance row carries: the work item, its governing evidence artifact, its
recorded merge SHA (from the development-state machine files — Git history is
authoritative for merge facts), the ancestor-of-HEAD proof, the commit-subject
containment proof, and the status. The honest-handoff ledger records every
finding, deferral, condition and orphan WITH its owner and its recorded
disposition — a deferral with an owner and a recorded rationale is closed-out
honesty, not an open defect; a missing disposition is a stop condition.

## Regeneration

```bash
node scripts/generate_final_reconciliation_matrix.mjs
```

Deterministic: the derivation is a pure function of the state files + Git
history (no timestamps, no wall clock). The closure gate
(`scripts/test_system_closure.mjs`) re-derives and cross-checks the committed
matrix on every run.
